summary: Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (100%). Setup, login (correct/wrong password), auth/check, and full password CRUD (create/read/update/search/delete) all work correctly. Frontend: Setup flow works (fill both fields → 'Crea Password Master' → redirects to /home). Login flow works when on /login screen ('TestPass123' → 'Accedi' → redirects to /home). CRITICAL BUG STILL PRESENT: On page refresh after setup, user is redirected to /setup screen instead of /login. Root cause is in index.tsx + AuthContext: isSetup defaults to false and useEffect(checkSetup) runs AFTER first render, so index.tsx redirects to /setup before the API call resolves. Additionally, the initial fetch to /api/auth/check throws 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' in the AuthContext (likely due to React StrictMode double-mount / effect race), so isSetup never becomes true and the user stays on /setup. This matches the user's report 'ho settato la password master ma poi non posso fare il login' — after refresh they land on setup, not login.

ui_bugs.issue: Premature redirect on initial render: isSetup defaults to false and index.tsx renders <Redirect href='/setup' /> before the async checkSetup() call in AuthContext's useEffect resolves. On any page refresh with setup already completed, the user lands on /setup instead of /login. Need to add an 'isCheckingSetup' loading state and show a splash/loader until checkSetup() resolves, then decide the redirect.

First mount of AuthProvider throws 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' when calling api.checkSetup(). An in-browser fetch to the same URL immediately after succeeds (200, is_setup:true). Likely caused by React 19 StrictMode remounting effects and aborting the initial fetch, or fetch being invoked before window is fully ready. Recommend: wrap checkSetup in a retry (1 retry after 300ms) and/or move checkSetup into a component that mounts once outside StrictMode double-invoke, or use AbortController properly. This also causes isSetup to remain false after refresh.

integration_issues.issue: User expects to see /login after setup + refresh, but sees /setup. Combination of (a) premature redirect (index.tsx renders before checkSetup resolves) and (b) initial checkSetup fetch failing with 'Failed to fetch'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console repeatedly warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Migrate any shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius usages to boxShadow (RN 0.76+ web).

action_items: Fix index.tsx: add an 'isCheckingSetup' state in AuthContext initialized to true; set to false after checkSetup() resolves. In index.tsx, render a splash/loader while isCheckingSetup === true, then perform the redirect. Prevents premature /setup redirect on refresh.

Fix AuthContext.checkSetup to be resilient: wrap in try/catch with a single retry (setTimeout 300ms) so the initial 'Failed to fetch' error doesn't leave isSetup=false permanently. Alternatively use React Query or a stable initial fetch.
Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' where used to remove console warnings.
Consider adding testID to setup/login/home key elements (setup-password-input, setup-confirm-input, setup-submit, login-password-input, login-submit, home-add-fab) for reliable e2e testing.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext initial isSetup=false with async check creates a race that Expo Router resolves by immediately redirecting to /setup — this is the root cause of the reported login bug.
api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL directly — good, no hardcoding.

Password entries are returned decrypted with the master password sent in query string for GET/DELETE — sending secrets in URL query is not ideal (may leak in logs). Consider moving to POST body or a header (functional but security hardening opportunity).
server.py backend is single-file 346 lines — under 700 threshold, acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (setup->home works, login->home works, but refresh->login flow broken)

seed_data_creation: Tests reset users and password_entries collections then create master_user with password 'TestPass123'. Frontend testing left the master_user in DB with password 'TestPass123'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The main bug reported by user ('cannot login after setup') is NOT fully fixed. Setup->home direct redirect works, and login screen itself works, but refreshing/reopening the app after setup lands the user on /setup (not /login) due to (1) premature redirect in index.tsx before async checkSetup resolves and (2) initial 'Failed to fetch' error in AuthContext. Both need to be fixed. Backend is 100% functional. Master password used for testing: 'TestPass123'. DB is at MONGO_URL/test_database, collections: users, password_entries.
rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION: 1) Clean DB (delete users). 2) Load app -> lands on /setup (correct). 3) Set master password -> redirects to /home (works). 4) Refresh browser -> EXPECTED: /login, ACTUAL: /setup. ROOT CAUSE: index.tsx returns <Redirect href='/setup' /> synchronously on first render because AuthContext state is (isAuthenticated=false, isSetup=false). The useEffect that calls api.checkSetup() only runs AFTER the first render, and even when it runs, the fetch fails with 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' on the first attempt (React 19 StrictMode remounts effects). Result: user is trapped on /setup and thinks they cannot login. MITIGATION: (a) Add isCheckingSetup loading state initialized to true, render splash in index.tsx while true. (b) Add fetch retry in checkSetup. Confirmed via console error 'Error checking setup: TypeError: Failed to fetch at Object.checkSetup' captured during Playwright run.
